meta.frame: +X tip, +Y spine, Z thickness; -Z face = FRONT reference, +Z face = BACK

thickness.basis: guard half-thickness stays anchored to the one measurable Z side face in the references; every other part is INFERRED by scaling the handle stack so the grip slab reaches the real Classic Knife ratio of ~1:13 (thickness:overall length). No supplied view resolves depth. Previous values put the grip at 1:19.9, which read as sheet metal when orbited.

priorValues.basis: inferred from the width of the guard's visible Z side face and typical fixed-blade proportions; no supplied view resolves depth

jimping.note: read off the alpha trace: 6 contiguous runs of top-edge depth

ferruleBeads.note: stochastic braid; exact bead layout is an approximation

grind.note: wedge grind inferred from the straight tonal break across the blade face

chamfer.basis: the previous superellipse profile returned z=0 at t=0 and t=1, so every furniture part feathered to a zero-thickness knife edge along its whole outline -- the cause of the 'bent sheet metal' read at grazing angles. Edge thickness is inferred.

joinery.basis: interior joinery is INFERRED -- neither view shows inside the handle. Tenons are inset in Y from the traced outline so the extended stubs stay strictly inside the neighbouring part's silhouette and cannot change silhouette IoU.
